gate.title: Account features
gate.cabinetError: Couldn't open My account. Check your connection and try again.
gate.body.webinar: Webinar participation and access to Q&A sessions are part of your account's extended features. Go to My account to enable them.
gate.body.assistant: Moving from astrological guidance to the level of psychology and behavioural practices aimed at expanding the biostochastic matrix of your states requires substantial computing power. You can enable it in My account.
gate.body.practices: Yoga practices are the core of the system, connecting physiology and mental states. Access to this library, as well as to weekly group sessions, is available to users with the “Master” profile level. You can change your access level in My account.
gate.body.personal: Personal calculations based on your exact birth date, time and place are part of your account's extended features. You can change your access settings in My account.
gate.body.default: This feature is part of your account's extended capabilities. You can change your access settings in My account.
gate.trialEnded.title: Demo period ended
gate.trialEnded.body: Your demo period has ended. Your account has been switched to the basic “Navigator” level, which includes universal recommendations. Access to the personal psychology module, individual birth-time calculations and the yoga practice library is not included at this level. You can change your access settings in My account.
gate.tierChanged.title: Profile level updated
gate.tierChanged.body: Thank you! Your profile has been upgraded from “{from}” to “{to}”. The new features are already available in the app.
gate.homePanel.title: Turn on personal recommendations…
gate.homePanel.body: You are currently viewing universal recommendations for today. They help you get a feel for the day's overall tendencies. A personal calculation based on your exact birth date, time and place, however, offers far greater precision and depth. You can switch your recommendation settings in My account.
